delete.description: Registered only when ACCOUNT_DELETION_ENABLED=true. Every request, including an identity-scoped replay, requires recent authentication. The verified issuer/subject is the replay key; no Idempotency-Key header is accepted. A replay resumes durable externalization and returns the original operation. ACCOUNT_DELETION_UNAVAILABLE is unusual: the account is already locally deletion_pending, ordinary access remains blocked, and the worker/operator owns completion even though the external tombstone was not yet acknowledged durable.

202.description: Deletion accepted or identity-scoped replay; clients must immediately clear credentials and account-owned local data

400.description: INVALID_REQUEST when the DELETE body is non-empty or any Idempotency-Key header is supplied

429.description: RATE_LIMITED for a new operation only; identity-scoped replays never consume quota

Retry-After.description: Seconds before retry

503.description: ACCOUNT_DELETION_UNAVAILABLE proves post-commit local disable and asynchronous ownership. SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE is ambiguous and never asserts acceptance. Clients fail closed for either response after dispatch.

Retry-After.description: Seconds before retry

post.description: Creates a bounded queue or discovery brief through the canonical reading-feed gate; never prepares a paper. Omitted mode and brief size use current research-profile defaults when profiles are enabled. An explicit mode wins, while an unavailable profile safely falls back to Recent and the service-default size.
Persists the next resume position with an idempotency key and progress revision. Completing a brief never changes library state or proves queue emptiness.

get.description: Returns the authenticated queue-first feed and current shadow/strict rollout policy from one account-scoped snapshot. Active To Read rows always suppress recommendations, and this route never schedules paper preparation. When recommendation_mode is omitted, the current research-profile preference is used if profiles are enabled; an unavailable profile safely falls back to Recent. An explicit query always wins, and the effective mode is bound into every cursor. An optional brief_id adds only an authority-revalidated progress summary; brief creation, selection, and mutation remain owned by the dedicated /v1/me/reading-briefs endpoints. Registered only when accounts, library, and reading feed are enabled.

ProfileUpdateBody.description:
Supported compare-and-swap fields for `PATCH /v1/me`. All properties are
optional, while an explicit JSON null is meaningful only for
`display_name`.

batch_id.description:
Server-created provenance for this recommendation page; null exactly
when `batch_metadata` is null. It may coexist with `next_cursor`, and a
continuation can carry a different page-scoped batch identifier.

oneOf.description:
Immutable persisted batch authority and implementation versions;
present exactly when `batch_id` is present.

ResearchAnnotationImportBody.description:
Importable annotation subset of `pakperk.research-export.v1`. Other fields
in the full research export are intentionally ignored by this narrowly
scoped endpoint rather than being represented as caller authority.

export_page.description: Page metadata is transport state, not annotation import authority.

queue_override.description:
These settings configure only the future fallback after server-proven
queue emptiness; they never change queue state.

end_offset.description: Exclusive Unicode-scalar offset into the exact source block.

start_offset.description: Inclusive Unicode-scalar offset into the exact source block.

source_page_url.description:
Exact retained PDF version plus a standards-compatible page fragment.
Absent when extraction did not provide a trustworthy source page.
